name: Deepest Grievances
source:
A gruesome murder strikes the nation's most inefficient institution!
Join an overworked Detective and his unlucky companion in navigating the bureaucratic wasteland of the Department of Complaints. Stand in the Queue. Sign papers with blood. Awaken the Boss.
